cost_note: Distinct paid Jev judgments only; excludes writing, tool/data access, human review, and cached report regeneration.

reliability_target.note: Synthetic examples and tuning data cannot establish production reliability. Audits require independently human-labeled, representative held-out tickets under a frozen policy. Bounds are per stratum, not a simultaneous guarantee across brands. Human approval remains required.

limitations: All 47 examples are synthetic and labeled during development, not independently audited representative historical tickets.
The starter suite was used during rubric refinement; challenge and classification labels were fixed before their first live v2 runs.
Nine draft approvals are too few to establish 99.9% correctness; thresholds were not relaxed to improve the match rate.
No acknowledgement met the skip threshold, so safe suppression has not been demonstrated by these live examples.
All three classification mismatches are conservative routing abstentions; raw class predictions matched all 22 labels.
The suite does not measure writer quality, repair improvement, production incident rate, or end-to-end cost per accepted reply.
Human approval remains required. Audit support in a report never authorizes automatic sending.

repair_instructions: Remove filler, repeated apologies and irrelevant options. Make the answer direct and concise.
Rewrite the tone and identity to match the supplied brand rules and customer situation.
Remove factual claims and delivery predictions not supported by the evidence. Use only verified facts.
Remove unsolicited refunds, cancellations, discounts, and alternatives. Answer only what the customer asked.
